ValidationRule.description: Ownership is a required field when a related opportunity reaches proposal stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Opportunity_at_Proposal_Stage__c = TRUE, NOT(RecordType.Name = "Competitor"), NOT(RecordType.Name = "Partner"), ISPICKVAL(Ownership,""))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Ownership is a required field on the Account when a related Opportunity reaches proposal stage.
